CORPORATE TAX CODE (CNPJ) # 33,592,510/0001-54<BR>
BOARD OF TRADE REGISTRATION (NIRE) # 33,300,019,766
</DIV>


<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>EXCERPT OF THE MINUTES OF THE EXTRAORDINARY BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">On January&nbsp;14, 2011, at 10:30 am, Messrs.&nbsp;Ricardo Jos&#233; da Costa Flores (Chairman), M&#225;rio da
Silveira Teixeira J&#250;nior (Vice-Chairman), Jorge Luiz Pacheco, Renato da Cruz Gomes, Jos&#233; Ricardo
Sasseron, Oscar Augusto de Camargo Filho, Sandro Kohler Marcondes and Jos&#233; Mauro Mettrau Carneiro
da Cunha directors and Messrs.&nbsp;Hajime Tonoki and Paulo Sergio Moreira, alternates, met at the
Vale&#146;s head office, at Avenida Gra&#231;a Aranha, 26, 19<SUP style="font-size: 85%; vertical-align: text-top">th</SUP> floor, Rio de Janeiro. Also
present were Messrs An&#237;bal Moreira dos Santos and Antonio Jos&#233; de Figueiredo Ferreira, effective
members of the Fiscal Council, pursuant to Article&nbsp;163, &#167;3&#186; of Law #6,404/76. Therefore, the
following issue was unanimously resolved: &#147;<B>3.1.1 PAYMENT OF THE EXTRAORDINARY REMUNERATION TO
VALE&#146;S SHAREHOLDERS </B>&#151; In lieu with Vale&#145;s Dividend Policy to the Shareholder, approved in the
Extraordinary General Shareholder Meeting held on April&nbsp;27, 2005 the Board of Directors approved,
with favorable opinion issued by the Fiscal Council as reported by its members, Messrs An&#237;bal
Moreira dos Santos and Antonio Jos&#233; de Figueiredo Ferreira, who attended the meeting, pursuant to
Article&nbsp;163, &#167;3&#186; of Law #6,404/76, the extraordinary payment of the shareholder&#146;s remuneration,
from January&nbsp;31, 2011 on, of the total amount of R$1,670,100,000.00, which represents the
anticipation of profits of the fiscal year ended December&nbsp;31, 2010, as according to the June&nbsp;2010
financial statement. The total approved amount will be paid as of interest on shareholders equity,
equivalent to R$0.320048038 per outstanding common or preferred shares issued by Vale, and is
subject to withholding income tax at the current applicable rate. All the holders, which on January
14, 2011 have shares issued by Vale, and which on January&nbsp;19, 2011 have either Vale&#146;s American
Depositary Receipts or Vale&#146;s Hong Kong Depositary Receipts, the latter at the close of business,
shall be entitled to receive such payment.&#148; I hereby attest that the deliberations above were
excerpted from the Minutes taken from the Registry of the Minutes of the Board of Directors
Meetings of the Company.
</DIV>

<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Rio de Janeiro, January&nbsp;14, 2011.
</DIV>


<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Maria Isabel dos Santos Vieira<BR>
Secretary
</DIV>
